brief:
Jerusalem scholar Dr. Abdullah Maruf said the European Israel Leadership Network summit convening in occupied Jerusalem aims to salvage the occupation's reputation, which Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has damaged, Shehab Wire reported. Maruf, an expert on Jerusalem affairs, characterized the gathering as part of efforts by some European leaders to reverse the negative perception.

The summit reflects wider attempts to rehabilitate Israel's standing among European publics amid tensions over Netanyahu's policies and their regional consequences.
